sn35.239:1.1: tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭhe va dhamme sukhasomanassabahulo viharati yoni cassa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
sn35.239:1.3: indriyesu guttadvāro hoti bhojane mattaññū jāgariyaṃ anuyutto.
sn35.239:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti.
sn35.239:2.2: idha bhikkhave cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī
sn35.239:2.3: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
sn35.239:2.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī
sn35.239:2.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
sn35.239:2.10: seyyathāpi bhikkhave subhūmiyaṃ cātummahāpathe ājaññaratho yutto assaṭṭhito odhatapatodo tamenaṃ dakkho yoggācariyo assadammasārathi abhirūhitvā vāmena hatthena rasmiyo gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena patodaṃ gahetvā yenicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ sāreyyāpi paccāsāreyyāpi
sn35.239:2.11: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imesaṃ channaṃ indriyānaṃ ārakkhāya sikkhati saññamāya sikkhati damāya sikkhati upasamāya sikkhati.
sn35.239:2.12: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti
sn35.239:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hoti.
sn35.239:3.2: idha bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti
sn35.239:3.3: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsuparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.
sn35.239:3.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso vaṇṇaṃ ālimpeyya yāvadeva sevanatthāya seyyathā vā pana akkhaṃ abbhañjeyya yāvadeva bhārassa nittharaṇatthāya.
sn35.239:3.5: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti
sn35.239:3.6: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsuparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.
sn35.239:3.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hoti.
sn35.239:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti.
sn35.239:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti
sn35.239:4.3: rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti
sn35.239:4.4: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti pādena pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasi karitvā
sn35.239:4.5: rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
sn35.239:4.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgariyamanuyutto hoti.
sn35.239:4.7: imehi bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭhe va dhamme sukhasomanassabahulo viharati yoni cassa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāyāti.
